cohort: The study included 754 pregnant women who had a caesarean section and attended a teaching hospital in Osun, Nigeria.
finding: The study forecasted that future caesarean section births are likely to occur in women aged 25-30 years with gestational ages of 35-40 weeks, with pre- and post-term pregnancies and previous caesarean sections significantly increasing this probability.
gest_age: 35-40 weeks (forecasted for CS births), pre-term, post-term
